subject.title: feat: Auto-generate session titles from first user message

question: Should OpenClaw broaden generated titles from dashboard-only to default-on all first-turn sessions via `session.autoTitle`, or keep broader auto-titling behind an explicit opt-in/lazy product design?
rationale: The PR changes provider/data-disclosure and persisted session metadata behavior for existing users, and the open proposal tracks different defaults, trigger timing, and title-source policy.

options.title: Keep Broader Titles Opt-In
options.body: Require all-session generated titles to be default-off or explicitly enabled after docs, provider/privacy wording, and proof are in place.

options.title: Accept Default-On All Sessions
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally ship the broader default, but should own the upgrade disclosure and session-state semantics before merge.

options.title: Stay Dashboard-Only For Now
options.body: Close or pause this branch and handle non-dashboard auto-titling through the broader proposal instead.

recommendation.title: Keep Broader Titles Opt-In
recommendation.body: Require all-session generated titles to be default-off or explicitly enabled after docs, provider/privacy wording, and proof are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses session-list behavior, config defaults, utility-model routing, and the merged dashboard-title implementation where this handle has the strongest adjacent history.
